fields.summary_ko.0: Morgan Stanley maintains an Overweight rating on SpaceX (SPCX) with a $300 target price, offering over 100% upside from the current $139.94 price.
fields.summary_ko.1: Having rebounded 16% from the November 5 low of $120.39, it is consolidating below the key resistance level of $143 and the 60-day moving average, with $130-$133 range serving as near-term support.
fields.summary_ko.2: Morgan Stanley notes SpaceX is redirecting business focus toward robotics, mesh networking, and Physical AI infrastructure, with AI computing capacity expected to reach 8GW by end of 2027.
